name: normal-train

required.name: model
required.description: A compatible TAO model (e.g., clip, nvdinov2, grounding_dino)

required.name: train_dataset_uri
required.description: URI of the training dataset (e.g., s3://bucket/train/)

required.name: platform
required.description: Compute backend selected from scripts/list_tao_platforms.py output; do not derive choices by scanning platform docs or folders.

optional.name: long_running_enabled
optional.description: Whether the agent should stay attached and emit periodic status until completion. Prompt during launch intake; default true.

optional.name: status_interval_minutes
optional.description: Minutes between long-running status updates. Prompt during launch intake; default 5.

description: Standard single-step train/eval/export workflow for any TAO model.
